quick_mode.description: DEPRECATED legacy opt-in quick mode (kept for backward compat). Applies ONLY with `quick:` prefix.
quick_mode.note: Single source of truth for trivial vs non-trivial is the threshold table in phase-2-planning.hook.md. Do NOT duplicate rules here — this block is a pointer only and must not diverge.

guard_hooks.description: Non-phase triggers registered under hooks (phase-load-guidance, phase-guard-apply-rules, phase-guard-plan-approval, phase-recovery, post-merge-sync). They enforce the 5-phase order defined in CHARTER.md and are not separate workflow phases.

workflow_phase_config.description: Defines which phases each workflow type executes. Code-delivery workflows run all 5 phases. Analysis-only workflows (Jira Ticket Review, Code Review) skip Phases 2-4.

jira-ticket-review.note: Analysis-only workflow. Only Phase 1 (understand) and Phase 5 (report) apply. No planning, execution, or validation needed.

code-review.note: Review-only workflow. Only Phase 1 (understand context) and Phase 5 (report) apply. No planning, execution, or PR validation needed.

unit-test.note: Full 5-phase code-delivery workflow (Phase 3 writes test code).

sessionStart.description: Load the hook index and phase-appropriate guidance before work begins.
Load workflow guidance, investigate context, and apply stack rules before planning.

sessionEnd.description: Run build and tests, and prepare PR output.
Generate final report and archive to .github/reports/.
Sync Jira ticket to Done and close sprint items after PR merge.

userPromptSubmitted.description: Create a draft plan and enforce approval gate for non-trivial requests.
Execute approved plan, update tests, and run lint/format checks.

preToolUse.description: Before read/search/context tools, verify guidance loading and rule application are complete.
Before code-edit tools, verify a draft plan has been presented; for non-trivial requests, ensure explicit developer approval.

postToolUse.description: After implementation steps, run lint/format checks.

errorOccurred.description: On errors, return to phase index, re-align phase order, and resume from the failing phase.
